description: This file contains macros and checks for verifying device register addresses against the Nordic Semiconductor MDK, accounting for hardware inconsistencies and supporting multiple SoC series.

methods.name: CHECK_DT_REG
methods.description: Macro to assert that a device tree node's 'reg' address matches the expected MDK address.

methods.name: NODE_ADDRESS
methods.description: Macro to select the correct address based on device tree compatibility.

methods.name: CHECK_SPI_REG
methods.description: Macro to check SPI register address.

methods.name: CHECK_I2C_REG
methods.description: Macro to check I2C register address.

methods.name: CHECK_UART_REG
methods.description: Macro to check UART register address.
